projects.page_description: Reba portfolio ya RIEC y'imishinga y'ubwubatsi n'ibishushanyo byarangiye mu turere tw'imiturire, ubucuruzi n'inganda.
projects.title: Ibikorwa.
projects.description: Icyegeranyo cy'imishinga y'ubwubatsi bw'indashyikirwa ya RIEC. Kuva ku bishushanyo by'inganda nini kugeza ku mazu y'ubwiza mu mujyi, dusobanura imiterere y'ejo hazaza binyuze mu buziranenge bw'imiterere.

plans.page_description: Reba gahunda z'ubwubatsi n'ibishushanyo bya RIEC ku mishinga y'imiturire, ubucuruzi n'inganda.

hero.description: Inziranenge n'udushya mu mutima w'imiterere yose dushushanya. Kuva ku gitekerezo cya mbere kugeza ku mashusho ya tekiniki y'iherezo.

blueprints.title: Amashusho ya Tekiniki
blueprints.description: Reba isomero ryacu ry'ibisubizo by'ubwubatsi bw'imiturire, ubucuruzi n'inganda.

spotlight.title: Igishushanyo cy'Inzu ya Eco-Villa
spotlight.description: Igishushanyo cyacu cy'imiturire cyibanze ku gukoresha ingufu neza, urumuri rw'ibanze, no guhuza imbere n'inyuma y'inzu. Iyi paketi yuzuye irimo inyandiko zose z'ubwubatsi zikenewe kugira ngo hemezwe kandi zubakwe.

how_we_plan.title: Uburyo Dutegura
how_we_plan.description: Uburyo bwacu bw'ubwubatsi bukomeye bureba ko buri murongo ushushanywa uhinduka imiterere ifatika, irambye, kandi ikora neza.

site.title: Ahantu & Igitekerezo
site.desc: Isesengura ry'imiterere y'ubutaka, kubahiriza amategeko, n'amashusho y'ibanze kugira ngo hasobanurwe icyerekezo.

design.title: Gushushanya Ubwubatsi
design.desc: Imibare y'imiterere, guhuza MEP, no guhuza tekinolojiya n'ibikoresho birambye.

specs.title: Amashusho y'Iherezo
specs.desc: Inyandiko z'ubwubatsi zarangiye, gahunda y'ibikoresho, n'amashusho ya tekiniki kugira ngo habeho amasoko.

cta.title: Ufite icyerekezo cyihariye?
cta.description: Kora hamwe n'abashushanya bacu bakuru n'inzobere kugira ngo mukore gahunda yihariye ikurikije ahantu n'ibyo ukeneye.

about.page_description: Wige ku ntego ya RIEC, indangagaciro, n'ikipe inyuma y'isosiyete ikomeye y'ubwubatsi n'ubwubatsi mu Rwanda.

values.title: Indangagaciro Nyamukuru
values.subtitle: Amahame ayobora ibyemezo byacu byose, kuva ku bisobanuro bito by'imiterere kugeza ku gahunda nini.

integrity.title: Ubunyangamugayo
integrity.desc: Twiyemeje amahame yo hejuru y'imyitwarire, tureba ko hari gusobanura no kuba inyangamugayo mu bufatanye bwose.

precision.title: Inziranenge
precision.desc: Ubunararibonye buri mu bisobanuro. Ubwubatsi bwacu bukomeye bureba ko buri miterere tubaka ari igihangano cy'inziranenge.

sustainability.title: Ibirambye
sustainability.desc: Kubaka ejo hazaza bisaba kubaha ibidukikije uyu munsi. Dushyira imbere ibikoresho n'uburyo bwiza ku bidukikije.

innovation.title: Udushya
innovation.desc: Twakira tekinolojiya zigezweho, kuva kuri BIM kugeza ku bikoresho byubatswe neza, kugira ngo dukemure ibibazo bigoye by'ubwubatsi.

1998.title: Gushinga RIEC
1998.desc: Intangiriro ry'icyerekezo. RIEC yashinzwe n'itsinda rito ry'injeniyeri 5 bafite intego yo guhindura imiterere y'ibyubakire mu akarere.

2005.title: Umushinga wa Mbere w'Inzu Ndende
2005.desc: Intambwe ikomeye. RIEC yarangije umushinga wayo wa mbere w'inzu ndende, ushyiraho inziranenge nshya y'ubwiza n'ibishushanyo mu karere.

2014.title: Kwaguka ku Isi
2014.desc: Ubuhanga bwa RIEC bumenyekanye ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Twafunguye ibiro byacu bya mbere hanze y'igihugu kandi twabonye imishinga mu bihugu byinshi muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba no hanze yayo.

2020.title: Igihembo cy'Igihugu cy'Udushya
2020.desc: Kwemezwa kubera ubunararibonye mu bwubatsi. Umushinga wacu wa 'Green-Steel' watsinze igihembo cy'Udushya mu Bwubatsi.

2024.title: Isezerano ryo Kurengera Ibidukikije
2024.desc: Kwiyemeza ejo hazaza rirambye. RIEC yiyemeje kugera ku 100% y'ibikorwa bidafite ingaruka ku bidukikije kuri buri hantu twubaka mu 2030.

team.title: Inzobere Zacu
team.subtitle: Ikipe yacu y'ubuyobozi ihuza imyaka myinshi y'uburambe mpuzamahanga mu bwubatsi, mucunga umushinga, n'ibishushanyo by'inyubako.

ceo.name: Libert IZERE
ceo.desc: Uyoboye RIEC afite icyerekezo, afite uburambe mu bwubatsi n'umugenzura w'umushinga.

operation_manager.name: Barnabe RWAKAZINA
operation_manager.desc: Yitondere ko imirimo y'umunsi ku munsi igenda neza kandi imishinga ikaba igasohoka mu gihe.

project_engineer.name: Jean Damascene MANIRAFASHA
project_engineer.desc: Inzobere mu bitekerezo by'ubwubatsi, igenamiterere, no kugenzura ubuziranenge bw'umushinga.

electrical_engineer.name: Serge Adelit MUHUZA
electrical_engineer.desc: Inzobere mu gushushanya sisitemu z'amashanyarazi, gukwirakwiza ingufu, n'ibisubizo by'ingufu birambye.

developer_it_manager.name: Rosine TUYISHIMIRE
developer_it_manager.role: UMUKORESHA WA TEKINIKI & UMUCUNGANZI WA IT
developer_it_manager.desc: Yicungura infrastructure ya RIEC, iterambere rya software, n'isisitemu z'IT kugira ngo isosiyete ibe ku rwego rwo hejuru.

site_engineer_assistant_operator.name: Tresor Alype BALINDA
site_engineer_assistant_operator.desc: Inkunga y'ubwubatsi ku mushinga no kugenzura ko imiterere y'ubwubatsi ihuye n'ibisabwa mu bwumvikane bwose.

contact.title: Twandikire
contact.subtitle: Witeguye gutangira umushinga wawe ukurikira? Twandikire ikipe yacu y'inzobere kugira ngo uhabwe inama.

hours.title: Amasaha y'Akazi
hours.weekday: Ku wa mbere - Ku wa gatanu:

payments_page.title: Ubwishyu
payments_page.subtitle: Gucunga ubwishyu n'ibikoresho byo kurura
payments_page.no_downloads: Nta dosiye ibonetse kuri iyi token.

hero.description: Kuva ku gitekerezo kugeza ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa, dutanga serivisi z'ubwubatsi z'ubuziranenge ku mazu, ubucuruzi n'imiryango. Dutanga serivisi nziza zo gushushanya, ubwubatsi no kubungabunga inyubako

intro.title: Icyerekezo cyacu
intro.text4: RIEC ihuza udushya mu by’ubwubatsi n’ubumenyi buhanitse mu kubaka, igahanga ibikorwaremezo biteye ishema kandi biramba. Ikipe yacu igizwe n’inzobere zifite ubunararibonye yitangira gutanga ibisubizo by’indashyikirwa kuva ku gitekerezo cya mbere kugeza ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa. Twiyemeje ubuziranenge, kurengera ibidukikije, no kunyurwa kw’abakiriya, tugashyira mu bikorwa icyerekezo cyawe mu buryo burambye kandi bwitondewe.

descriptions.surveying: Gupima neza ubutaka hakoreshejwe RTK-GPS na robotic total stations kugira ngo tubone amakuru y'ubutaka yuzuye.
descriptions.boundary_surveying: Kugena imbibi z'ubutaka mu buryo bw'amategeko n'inziranenge kugira ngo habeho umutekano no kubahiriza amategeko.
descriptions.topographic_surveying: Gukora ikarita y'imiterere y'ubutaka mu buryo bwa 3D n'amakuru y'intera z'ubutaka kugira ngo habeho isesengura ryuzuye ry'ahantu.
descriptions.construction_layout: Guhindura amashusho y'ubwubatsi mu bikorwa nyabyo hakoreshejwe uburyo bw'inziranenge bwo gushyiraho inkingi n'imirongo y'ubwubatsi.
descriptions.interior_design: Gutegura no gutunga imbere y'inzu mu buryo bwihariye kandi bwiza ku bihe by'ababyeyi n'ubucuruzi.
descriptions.house_design: Gutanga ibisubizo byuzuye byo kubaka inzu kuva ku gushushanya kugeza ku gutanga inzugi z'inzu.
descriptions.construction_supervision: Kugenzura ubwubatsi n'inziranenge za tekiniki kugira ngo habeho imiterere ikomeye no kubahiriza amahame mpuzamahanga y'umutekano.
descriptions.property_valuation: Gusesengura agaciro k'umutungo mu masoko no gukora isesengura ry'imari ku mutungo w'ubutaka n'ibikorwa remezo.

projects.title: Imishinga Yacu Iheruka
projects.description: Imishinga yacu iheruka ni ubuhamya bw'ubwitange n'ubumenyi bwacu. Iyi mishinga igaragaza ibisubizo by'akazi kacu gakomeje.

solutions.title: Ibisubizo Dutanga
solutions.description: Dutanga ibisubizo byuzuye by'ubwubatsi bikurikije ibyo ukeneye. Kuva ku gutegura no gushushanya kugeza ku gukora no kubungabunga, tureba ko buri mushinga utangwa mu buryo bw'inziranenge kandi bw'ubuziranenge.

plan.title: Gutegura no Kwerekana
plan.description: Dutangira no gutegura umushinga, gusesengura ahantu, no gushushanya mu buryo bwa 3D kugira ngo ubone neza uko umwanya uzaba umeze mbere y'uko ubwubatsi butangira.

build.title: Kubaka no Gukora
build.description: Ikipe yacu y'inzobere ikora imirimo yose y'ubwubatsi mu buryo bw'inziranenge — kuva ku miterere kugeza ku kurangiza — tureba ko hari ubuziranenge, umutekano, n'imikorere myiza kuri buri cyiciro.

renovate.title: Kuvugurura no Guhindura
renovate.description: Niba ari uguteza imbere icyumba cyangwa gushushanya umwanya wose, tuzana impinduka zigezweho, zikoreshwa neza, kandi ziremereye ku nyubako zihari.

deliver.title: Gutanga no Gutera Inkunga
deliver.description: Iyo byarangiye, dutanga umushinga wuzuye hamwe no kugenzura ubuziranenge kandi tukomeza gutanga serivisi zo kubungabunga no gutera inkunga iyo bikenewe.

footer.brand_description: Dushushanya kandi tubaka imyanya ihuza udushya n'ubuhanga. Buri mushinga ukorwa mu buryo bw'inziranenge, ubuhanga, n'ubwitange bukomeye ku buziranenge. Icyerekezo cyawe cy'inyubako gitangira ku bumenyi bwacu.
